metadata.case_name: NGAN PIK HA v. WONG SAU LAI

injuries.icd_description: Fracture at wrist or hand level, unspecified

injuries.description: a fractured dislocation of a number of metatarsols in her right foot
source: a fractured dislocation of a number of metatarsols in her right foot
injuries.icd_description: Multiple injuries of ankle or foot

manifestations.description: The right wrist and hand is weaker than before. She is unable to lift up object of more than a few lbs.
Mdm Ngan cannot hold chopstick with her right hand, she prefers to use a spoon held by left hand for eating.
There is tremor over right hand when holding objects.
There was stiffness and weakness of the wrist and a very weak grip.
The right hip is painful during walking.
She has difficulty in lifting her right thigh up fully and sitting tolerance is about 30 minutes.
The right foot is more painful than the right hip during weight bearing; she has to use a quadripod to assist walking and walks with an unsteady gait.
There is impaired sensation over dorsum of right foot.
There is frequent attacks of muscle cramps over small muscle of right foot.
She is constantly in pain and cannot walk any distance without the quadripod; ongoing pain and stiffness.

treatments_received: closed reduction and dynamic hip screw (right hip)
closed reduction, K-wire fixation and fasciotomy of the right foot
closed reduction of the right wrist with application of an external fixator
debridement of the right foot wound
skin graft from left thigh to close right foot wound
removal of external fixator and K-wire
rehabilitation at Tung Wah Eastern Hospital
treatments_future: part-time domestic helper (clinically justified by Dr Tsoi)

losses.description: The accident has put paid to that independence; she regards herself as a disabled person and a burden on her family.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: She can undertake simple household chores and simple cooking but nothing more; she was obliged to call upon support of family and paid help.
She cannot walk any distance without the quadripod and walks with an unsteady gait.
She has only partial use of her right hand.

losses.category: Loss of confidence in going out in the public
losses.description: She does not venture out alone, for fear of falling.
